findings.title: Jennifer B. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
I am a Marriott Titanium Elite loyalty member whose stayed over 500 nights at Marriotts and close to 50 thus far this year.  In late July I inadvertently booked the prepay rate at the Phoenician for December and was then charged $2027 on my credit card.  On August 8, when I realized what I'd done, I went to cancel the reservation and saw that it had to be cancelled within 24 hours.  I've now spent close to a month since then trying to get my money back and am not even getting a response!  I was told by Marriott that it is a local property decision and after going through the hotel's process, they denied my request.  I subsequently was told by another hotel representative that they would address the situation and have not heard thing in well over a week despite two additional e-mail inquiries.  I am incredibly disappointed in Marriott and the Phoenician for the following reasons:
1) It is not clear enough on Marriott's website that you are about to be charged for a pre-pay.  It looks too much like a regular reservation. 
2) A 24 hour cancellation window is basically just a money grab, as there isn't anything the hotel is going to do with the room requiring that short a window.
3) It is ridiculous that Marriott would leave their loyalty program in the hands of an individual property.  I've subsequently cancelled 7 additional Marriott reservations I had this year, as I travel over 100,000 air miles and at least 20 weeks per year. 
4) The Marriott customer service people were HORRIBLE!  They acted like I was just a bother, not someone at a premier loyalty level.
5) There is absolutely no reason the Phoenician couldn't give me at least some of the pre-pay back, if not all.  It's not like I cancelled even a month in advance - I cancelled with over FOUR MONTHS for them to book the room, which I'm sure they will during the holiday season.

While the hotel may be nice, Marriott and the hotel's customer service are something to be very concerned about if you are considering staying!

findings.title: Monica P. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I was lucky enough to have a staycation here at the Phoenician resort. I went to the spa and it was extremely nice and it was very well taken care of. The rooms were immaculate and very comfortable and the restaurants at the hotel were really great. The service at all times was 1st class and I felt very pampered for the whole weekend that we stayed here. Thanks to everyone at the hotel for making our stay a very memorable experience.

findings.title: Tim B. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
The multiple pools are gorgeous, clean and so inviting.

The rooms are good, yet have a stuffy, stiff Charles Keating feel. 

The grounds and architecture is most thoughtful, entertaining, and explore worthy.

The service is proficient, well trained, yet again, stiff. 

I didn't eat the hotel food, choosing to visit a small, intimate Scottsdale sushi restaurant instead (different review). 

The hotel bar was all good. Proficient and pricey.

The hotel basement or catacombs had a European flare, offering cute, expensive little shops. So, you don't have to leave the hotel to get your souvenir and art shopping on.

Forewarning: be prepared to get nickel and dimed for EVERYTHING. Hotel parking - ching! Newspaper - ching! You get the Keating idea.

If you don't know the Charles Keating story, it is worth the research. He made a wide stamp on the Valley, and he was on his way to run for Trump's position before the savings and loan bust.

The Phoenician was a Keating landmark.

And, while the Phoenician is a remarkable product, Keating was not.

People lost their life savings to Keating schemes. Powerful senators were pulled into the muck with Keating. 

Phoenician good; Keating very bad.

You know the myth of sysiphus? His punishment from Zues was to roll a boulder to the top of a mountain - perpetually. This would be Keating worthy.

Anyway, the Phoenician pools are worth the admission price. Not to be missed.

findings.title: Ryan C. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Got an amazing rate during off-season and finally got a chance to stay at the Phoenician. One thing to note - you need more than one day to actually enjoy all the amazing amenities they have.

First, the property is massive. So big that we actually got lost trying to get to the main registration. Once you're there, you have your choice of valet or self-park to leave your car.

Everyone at the resort is super friendly. Maxwell checked us in swiftly, gave us the rundown of all that's offered and then sent us on our merry way. The rooms themselves were overly spacious and I loved the view overlooking the pool and golf course. Made for a serene wake up watching the sun peek up over the course.

A big plus in the rooms: you can stream your devices to the TV. We were able to binge Hulu/Netflix to our heart's desire while indulging in some pre-sleeping desserts from room service (get the cheesecake!)

There's three pools that are open 24-hours a day and heated to 85-degrees. Because of timing, we didn't get to partake unfortunately, but we did get to eat/imbibe at the Phoenician Tavern on-site. I'd recommend it as the food was delicious and so were the cocktails.

We'd definitely stay there again, probably not during peak season - but whenever the rates are within reason. Hopefully I'll be able to enjoy all the great stuff offered the next time around!

findings.title: Sandy R. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Amazing place but Mowry and Cotton, the Restaurant, not good at all. Came here for a staycation. Everybody that works here is very nice, the pool is amazing. I don't like to golf  and I don't like to play tennis so really all I want to do is eat good food and hang out by the pool. Was here on a Monday so I guess the steakhouse is closed which is really the only place I want to eat. so we have to go to the only other restaurant in the building. Another couple that we were with said don't go there because it's not that good.

findings.title: Isabella J. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Finally stayed the infamous Phoenician. Their Summer rates are worth taking advantage for more than just one night, which was the duration of my stay. The property is well maintained and I love that it's built into the into the mountain, so it blends in! The resort has several pools, restaurants, a huge fitness center and spa, which I wish I had time to enjoy! Everyone I interacted with on staff was friendly and professional!  In short, this review is for the room experience. The room was huge but I found the cleanliness to be less than five stars. It was super dusty, table tops weren't wiped, the bathroom trays had stains on them.  For a luxury resort, cleanliness should never be an issue. As beautiful as the property is, I don't think I'd stay here during high season at their full price.

findings.title: Jerry D. (2/5)
findings.snippet: Place is amazing. Pool, bars and everything else 5 star. Food.... not so much. One terrible restaurant you could go to and it was garbage. They said there was some other restaurant you could go to but you had to ride a cart to get there and I wasn't in the mood to walk home in the hot sun from some restaurant. Steakhouse was closed. The only place we wanted to go. Some other people that were with us we're going to get a cab and go up to Mastro's, another couple was going to try to order a pizza. I would have rather had peanut butter and jelly than there terrible Restaurant. Mowry and Cotton is the place. Raw meat, old baked potatoes. Seriously absolute terrible food. I took it personal, how dare you serve my wife such garbage. If you don't know what your doing, close it down. We were going to stay extra days because it was so beautiful and friendly but we need food and you defiantly don't have anything to eat here other that potato chips and candy out of the mini bar.

findings.title: Lora M. (4/5)
findings.snippet: On a 110 degrees Arizona heat you need a hotel with a pool to splash into when the heat gets really intolerable. This hotel has it all, including pool side amazing service and delicious food. Complete with all the amenities, I couldn't ask for a better place to stay in while in Scottsdale.

findings.title: Zoe J. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
I just had the most amazing staycation at The Phoenician.

The entrance to the hotel is grand with a beautiful drive up. The grounds are perfectly manicured. 

Walking in, the lobby is modern and sleek and the front desk staff was so helpful. Daniel checked us in and made feel very welcome. He told us if we needed anything during our stay to reach out. Later in the evening we walked by the desk and asked where we could get deodorant. We spoke with a different agent, who said he would make sure he sent some to our room. Sure enough, when we returned to our room it was there.

One thing I especially liked was that the key packet holder has an insert for their resort map. It's was placed in there pre-folded and easy to carry around in your pocket. 

Our room was impeccable with modern decor and furnishings. I was very impressed with the bathroom counter space and the deep soaking tubs.

Next we went to the spa, which blew me away. It is brand new with three stories and it has a rooftop pool. It also is rated four stars by Forbes, to give a sense of how luxurious it is. Our check in experience was wonderful with Wayne, who recapped our services and introduced us to someone to show us to the locker room. 

The spa is set up in a way that you don't have to think about anything. For example in the showers, there was a towel, washcloth, pre packaged razor and shaving cream already there. In the lockers there was a tray for jewelry and a bag for your wet swimsuit. Small touches like those made all the difference. Not to mention, there were plenty of perfectly folded towels available everywhere. 

The relaxation area, sauna, steam room, and whirlpool jacuzzi area were all immaculate and top tier. As a heads up, these facilities are gender specific, not co-ed.

I was lucky to have Suzella as my massage therapist. She was kind and consultative the whole time I was in her care. I got the Sonoran Scrub, Wrap and Massage and it was heavenly. I felt secure and safe with the way I was covered/draped. Not once, did I feel uncomfortable. I fell asleep multiple times, which had never happened to me before. I was  100% relaxed. 

We ate dinner at The Phoenician Tavern later that evening. Giovanna was our server who provided us with great recommendations and service. Make sure to get the tater tots if you go there. They are delicious!!

There are many fine hotels to choose from in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area, but The Phoenician really sets the gold standard. 

Every aspect of the hotel was recently renovated and every person I interacted with was warm and helpful, even during short interactions. All expectations I had were exceeded. If you're thinking about staying here, just do it. The views and resort itself are gorgeous and you will be so well taken care of.

findings.title: Marcia B. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
The 2nd time we've stayed at The Phoenician and the resort is beautiful.  The grounds are gorgeous & well maintained as well as the main areas of the hotel - lobby, conference rooms, dining areas, & restrooms.  However,  the rooms we've stayed in were a huge disappointment.  Not only was the room very dirty when we checked in, it stayed that way the entire week.  Food debris, lint, etc. on the carpet was never vacuumed up. There was hair in the corners of the bathroom and the shower was obviously dirty.  In addition to being dirty, the condition was shabby.  The hand towel bar was about to come off the wall, the toilet door would not latch as the hardware was loose & didn't line up with the frame. The bathroom mirror had stains around the underside that appeared to be mildew, walls & trim had scuffs, large black marks in several places. Something spilt all over the bottom of the bathroom door.  We decided not to call this to the attention of anyone on staff because it wasn't worth the possible retaliation.  The last few days we were there, the cleaning crew did only the bare minimum and didn't even leave water bottles in our room (it's VERY hot in August and they typically leave 2 complimentary bottles per day).  Expected cleaner, better maintained rooms at a resort of this caliber.  

Most of the staff is polite and friendly.  There are a few staff members that are excellent!  While most of the food is not our favorite, we did find the new Tavern at the golf center was excellent.  The staff there was exceptional.  Our waitress, Lily, for several meals was one of the best we ever had anywhere.  Another waiter, Gino, at the Tavern and the Market (in the shopping area) was also exceptional.  Both very pleasant, prompt service and they went out of there way to make sure we were pleased & had everything we needed. Also, the staff at the pool does an amazing job - as hot as it is hot there, they're pleasant & promptly replacing water pitchers, bringing orders, etc.  Not sure about the food servers, but I never saw anyone else tip the towel guys.  Please tip, they do a great job!

Lastly, there is a huge problem with the redesign on the first floor.  When we were there last year, several areas were under construction and this was not an issue.  However, now there is no access from the first floor guest rooms to the convention area without going up to the lobby and back down on the other elevators or the escalator.  You can go outside and through the Mowry & Cotton restaurant patio or down to the pool & through to the other side.  Because there's not even a sidewalk across the lawn.  If the restaurant is busy, it's a little awkward to walk through everyone eating on patio.  I don't understand the cut off???  We were there for a show and made daily trips to the convention hall - two with a large case of samples & display items.  It was very inconvenient to go up, across the lobby & back down.

If  this show is at this property again, we'll know better than to accept a room on the first floor.  Hopefully, the rooms will be updated and cleaned at the same standard as the rest of the hotel.

findings.title: Courtney M. (3/5)
findings.snippet: We've had two great vacations at this resort with our children. The pools, slides, rooms, grounds & restaurants are fabulous! Last year was incredible, this stay however we had a horrible experience at the 'mixology' class that was offered. The bartender was fabulous.... the issue was a family with THREE young children hanging in the bar area (that was closed for our private class). These folks were rude and loud... it was really frustrating trying to hear the bartender explain drink combinations with these obnoxious people with their young children. My husband & I purposely took this class to not only learn new drink concoctions but to have a break from our children! I had to leave early I was so annoyed at their constant conversations over the bartender and in dealing with their children the entire time. Then they had the nerve to ask the bartender to get them tomatoes because their children wanted them! Children should NOT be allowed at this event! Everyone at the resort is so nice that they don't want to tell people negative things... but this ruined it for me.

findings.title: Pat K. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
I can not say enough about the check in at the Phoenician's.  The patience and kindness that Kamdem
Showed us! Kamdem customer service is a 10+.

findings.title: Quinn K. (2/5)
findings.snippet: Since the remodel in 2018 I've noticed things look nicer and newer but that definitely doesn't translate into a 5 star resort. I live on the course so this review isn't based on a single visit. Beautiful grounds but overpriced restaurants with less than average food. This is huge because you're a 5 minute Uber from some of the best restaurants in the entire state. Also the newly remodeled golf course is terrible looking. And by terrible I mean there's dead and yellow grass in multiple places all the time. Wet spots are common, and greens are brown in areas. It's just not a 5 star place by any standards. Who's ever in charge of this place needs to rethink operations and quality. Especially since there are so many resort and golf options in the area that are way better.

findings.title: Scott R. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Lovely hotel with large comfortable rooms. Checking in was easy and the staff is very friendly and accommodating.

I will return.

findings.title: Mike W. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
For starters, the views are some of the best we've seen. I can't believe that after 25 years of living in the Valley, this is the first time I've made it to the Phoenician. 

The entire resort is gorgeous and we couldn't be happier with the room. Service is top notch. We are just debating whey or not to bring the kids next time.

findings.title: Ryan N. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Took my family here for a long holiday weekend and had an amazing time. Great service, wonderful room and grounds, and my kids loved the pool. We'll be coming back for sure

findings.title: Dani F. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Talk about an amazing escape! We had the best experience at the spa- wonderful amenities and such a relaxing time. Would 100% come back just for the spa. We loved the pool- poolside service did stop around 5pm just FYI for anyone getting drinks/using the water slide. But you can walk up to the outdoor bar and get drinks after poolside service ends. 

The rooms were incredible- a lot of towels in the bathroom and very clean/elegant looking overall. 

From start to finish the customer service was amazing! Would definitely stay here again.

findings.title: Kaylee G. (5/5)
findings.snippet: What an amazing experience.  Rooms were clean and spacious. ALL staff friendly, helpful and accommodating love the adult only pool (4 other pools and a kind of water park area for kids to use) the grounds are beautiful.  Nice athletic center and an amazing spa well worth visiting.... relaxation at its best and again an amazing staff. Beautiful mountain backdrop

findings.title: Amanda L. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
We enjoyed our stay here very much!
We went over Memorial Day weekend, and didn't leave the property (except to hike Camelback Mountain) for the entire 3 days. Several restaurants - all were great! Lost count of how many pools. Spa was lovely. If golfing is your thing, they have that too. The nature trails were a wonderful little escape. We will definitely return!

findings.title: Ra R. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The hotel bar is fabulous...... it's amazing. The bartenders are lovely and let you try all the wine. I love this place.

findings.title: Amy S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Wow! This place is amazing! Everything from the service to the staff and all the amenities really make this place special. I am a bit critical of hotels but no complaints on anything here. We will be back.

findings.title: Alyssa R. (2/5)
findings.snippet: It's really hot and walking around on the outside was scorching. there are no misters or anything to keep you cool. No shade or people. The pool was hard to find the staff was hard to find. Maybe this is a good place to go in the winter.

findings.title: Katie J. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Marriott hits another one out of the park.  I wasn't here for pleasure, but if I were, I would have never had to leave the resort and there would have been PLENTY of great things to do, keep me busy or help me relax.  The staff was very accommodating.  My family felt like celebrities they were so well cared for.  The grounds are beautiful and vast.  The pool and pool service was phenomenal.  The rooms were luxurious and spacious.  I simply adore a big shower separate from a garden tub.  Marriott hasn't let me down yet and the Bon Voy rewards program is great!

findings.title: Katherine B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Stayed at the Canyon Suites (again) and had the best experience! The individualized service makes a difference! Everyone there strives to meet your needs and makes you feel special! I loved that the pool at the suites is more private than at the main hotel are. The cabana rental is very worthwhile! The food and drinks are always top notch! Although the prices are higher they don't charge you for every little item. I would rather pay more and have an all- inclusive feel! The views of the mountain can't be beat! Planning on coming back!

findings.title: Tom R. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
Wow!  From start to finish this was an amazing Father's Day staycation!  Maxwell was amazing at checkin and Johana and Taylor made sure my room would be perfect before my arrival!

The facilities, grounds, pools and restaurants are impeccable!

Thank you everyone!

findings.title: Cindy C. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
Had a company outing this evening. My guest and I could not find our way to the ballroom where the event was held as the place is huge. I was hungry and our company had fried food apps that I was not interested in even though it was our annual awards ceremony. I was told that we could go to the Tavern on-site. We got there and they were closed. We walked back to the resort and ended up on the third floor at a bar serving food and ordered caesar salads w chicken. They arrived w/o any dressing. I was so frustrated after waiting for 10-15 minutes that I went to the room and ordered room service. It is now 11 pm and I have still not had dinner yet. I am a foodie and am well traveled. I am not impressed with the resort and don't expect to return. Save your money and stay at a 4 star resort instead. Overall, 
I was hoping to have one evening in which to celebrate w/o any
glitches. Overall, terribly disappointed as I was hoping to have an enjoyable experience.

findings.title: Susan R. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
As the sun drops over the Phoenician a little sigh leaves your breathless. 

This piece of luxury needs no coming from the ashes since it is perfection. 

The views of the Phoenician are always irresistible and beautiful. This diamond star hotel provides its guests sheer excellence and bliss. 
They have always made my stay in Phoenix magical; either on business or pleasure.

When I return to Phoenix for business usually, this is my go to "only" spot that I ever stay! I originally called Arizona my home for over a decade. Having much history here especially on the golf course. My husband, prior to his passing loved to play golf here. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone that just needs to catch their breath. They are family friendly and always cater to my twins while I'm away in the city. Usually the twins have a wonderful playground here while I'm off with meetings or court this time from Las Vegas. The breathtaking views of a wonderful pool that's in the shape of a Myan temple scream get over here. Where's your cocktail? When it gets too hot we go inside to a relaxing movies from the room that are still in theaters. The spa is another place that one can adjourn too. While these are not all children friendly places, the parents need relaxing way more than the kids. Truly amazing times for all members of the family. What more could my sixteen year old twins need while mama is away; except room service. Plus while I'm on the resorts property I'm only a phone call away and they will survive, I'm sure. If all else fails the room service will busy them. Truly anything you need just let the concierge know, they will make it happen for you down to the smallest details. 

While I am here I rarely spend time in the room since the beauty is outside on the grounds. Just because I am a guest here I still need to visit the  gym and get my cardio. The need to get your exercise while away from home does not stop. Gym is the second need in life aside from coffee being first. Whatever gym you visit this little place is state of the art and will fit your lifting needs. The spring weather is beautiful here is Scottsdale with sun rises while you jog the grounds in the morning are breathtaking. While in the summer time I would not recommend walking certain parts of the grounds during the day with the extreme triple digit temperatures; dawn and dusk are your best ways of enjoying your exercise outdoors. The running trail has some shade and is set in true Arizona desert setting. The incorporation of the natural setting here is beautiful with indigenous flora and fauna all around the resort. Pack your Nike's, you will lace them up as you run with the sun as it rises or sets.

What's the most important part of the hotel while away from home, except the food. I'll tell you it's the bed. Big fluffy pillows beacon and scream jump onto me and get comfortable as you unpack and freshen up. Sitting on the edge of my bed it's so bouncy. I enjoyed sleeping on this bed. When you lay your head on the pillows you forget your lying down and being hugged by the mattress. The room can be controlled by the air conditioning that is located in the room. The room has black out shades so the sun does not greet you at 5 o'clock am unexpectedly. The bathroom includes all the amenities that one would need to do the basics with. Unfortunately, for us ladies our bathroom beauty regime regardless if on vacation or not comes with us. The vanity is beautiful with plenty of light and room for all our cosmetics.The bathtub is perfect all it needs is a bath bomb and it's time for a relaxing luxurious bath. Soak up that bliss with a glass of champagne and bubbles.

The staff here has been so supportive over the years. They will go out of their way to make all your dreams a reality. I requested strawberries and champagne in my room, and when I checked in they bellhop greeted me with it on a tray. The champagne was already chilled too. The strawberries were delightful and fresh. It seems like they dipped them, then brought them too me. It would not surprise me. The check in and check out process was infallible with ease. The valet is one of the fastest that I have ever experienced. Tell the valet to keep the car close if you need it. They will accommodate, tip good service extra well. That's all I have to state on tips. They will remember. 

While this trip to the Valley of the Sun was not something that I wanted to go for it has to be done. The stay at this hotel made all the difference. I felt like family here. My stay was so magical and wonderful. As I watch the sun set from my balcony the lounge is where you will find me. The bartender I've heard makes great drinks. Or at least he did last time I was here. The hour of cocktails is slowly approaching and this sunset is not going to toast itself. Cheers! Salut. Prost! A fantastic evening to you as the hues of the sun spill over the sky and create bliss for me to witness!

findings.title: Hilary L. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
We recently join the resort as golf and resort membership. Mind you, this membership is $700 a month for a couple. We were at the pool (which is an included benefit of the membership) on Sunday May 26th and we wanted to order some food poolside. The server asked for the room number and last name, and I gave him my resort card and said we are members. He handed it back and began to tell us that we had to leave. I was confused and I asked him why. He said that there are blackout dates for the pool and that we needed to leave immediately. I was very apologetic and explained to him that this was our first month having the membership and that we were unaware of the black out policy and asked if we could stay, and just not order food. He got very defensive and said that he would have his manger come over and ask us to leave if we didn't not leave immediately. 
I was very taken back by his mannerism and how rude he was to us. He acted like we were teenagers who snuck into the pool! I was extremely embarrassed, especially that the guests near us could hear the conversation. Now I am upset and embarrassed to even come back to the resort for any matter (golf, pool, fitness) I feel that the situation could have been handled differently or maybe even given a pass for the day since it's our first month of membership and we weren't aware of the policy. Moving forward I hope that the hotel management can understand that each customer should be treated as a person with respect and equality. Especially if they are a paying customer and member of the resort! Really distraught and very disappointed to have to leave this review. I was quite excited to have this membership which would be $8,400 a year, but now I am rethinking our choice due to the poor treatment and lack of respect as a patron.

findings.title: S P. (1/5)
findings.snippet: This is a very nice resort with great restaurants and bars but the service and management of the hotel is very poor.  They did not give us the rooms we booked, despite our party reconfirming the arrangements several times.  They did not honor our cabana reservations despite us booking over a month in advance and confirming the day before arrival.  None of our rooms were clean as of 4 pm (some still unclean as of 5 pm) despite us being out of the rooms since 7 am and making multiple inquiries with housekeeping.  This type of housekeeping service makes it very challenging for a family with kids to allow the kids to rest and shower after the pool and before dinner.  When making inquiries about these issues the staff was very nonchalant.  Hotel management should promptly address their service levels if they want to be considered a luxury hotel.

findings.title: Joel R. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
I stayed at the Phoenician twice before the big renovation and enjoyed it.  This time I was placed in a "Casita" room with a view of a road and a wall.  Please note the pictures.  The manager refused to move me because they are at capacity.  Of course I have lifetime Titanium status etc but I don't expect to always get a better room because of that.  This room is simply unacceptable for a so-called luxury hotel.  

Avoid the Phoenician unless you are prepared to relax by the road watching paint chip.

findings.title: Jeremy G. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This is the best service I have EVER experienced. Food options are all good especially the gourmet dessert options at the marketplace! The deserts there was absolutely beautiful and delicious. So much so we took some home after eating 5! Buffett breakfast is better than others in the hotel industry since part of the food is the same as the afternoon tea. I mentioned our wedding anniversary and they did a few nice things to celebrate.

findings.title: Beela A. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Great customer service! They have 3 pools. This resort is better for families or couples to get away. It's very relaxing and beautiful. It is an upscale resort. Everything is very pricy. The food is not the best but the drinks are great! A lot of corporate events take place here because they have multiple ballrooms.

findings.title: Kelli J. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Great experience! The rooms are beautiful. We had a mountain and cactus garden as a view from our balcony which was very cool and different. The staff is as very friendly in the hotel and all the restaurants we we tried. I didn't have a chance to try the spa but it looked beautiful. Over all great get-a-way!

findings.title: Mary Ann M. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Absolute luxury hotel. Everyone so friendly, so helpful.   Room big and so perfect! Great bed also! Loved being here. Thank you to everyone who we met on staff!

findings.title: Joel M. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This is a GORGEOUS property. I highly recommend the balcony of the Thirsty Camel in the evening. We went to breakfast at the 19th hole twice where Pam and Rosa were very helpful. Doug Carpenter the Bell Captain was just superb.

findings.title: Cheryl S. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
We have eaten Easter brunch a few times in the last 10 years. I have to say that it gets worse every year but the price keeps going up.
Ten years ago is was $80 a person, they had everything you could imagine in the buffet menu and great service. They had fun activities for the kids and even gave away plush stuffed Easter bunnies. They had jugglers, and acrobatics on the upper lawn. On the lower lawn down from the pool they had great Easter egg hunts for all ages with the Easter bunny walking around for photos, buzz light year even showed up. This year they had some face painting and craft stands like a raunchy carnival and it's now $125 per person.
We called for a reservation about 4 weeks out and the waiting list was so long that they told us it would be a fat chance of being called, well Friday 4/19 and asked if we would like to come. Sure we said yes with all of the fond memories. 
The food selections were not exceptional, some food was cold, instead of being in a big ball room it was in a small restaurant, and the place really was desolate for a place that had such a long wait list. Anyway it wasn't worth the $800+ dollars we spent. We did see and get a picture with Larry Fitzgerald, that was our highlight.our server Amanda was smiley and pleasant but we had to continually ask for our drinks to be refilled

findings.title: Jessica B. (1/5)
findings.snippet: This hotel is AWEFUL. Just took my kids out for an Easter brunch and my 7 year old daughter and 13 year old son went to check out the pool. They were then threatened by the pool staff that they would be ARRESTED if they did not immediately get out of the pool area. I was and still am disgusted at the staff's horrible behavior and actions towards my kids. They could of just politely told them that they were not allowed in the area. But instead my 7 year old daughter was told she would be arrested by the police with her 13 year old brother if they didn't immediately leave. My daughter came back sobbing and her Easter was completely ruined. Never going back again.

findings.title: David J. (5/5)
findings.snippet: A great experience!  Yes this hotel is not inexpensive but I honestly feel like it is worth it.  Nuzzled into the south face of camelback this sprawling resort and golf club have something for everyone even kids.  4 pools, a water slide, kid water play area, ADULT only area, and amazing gym, newly redone spa, golf things (don't golf but people seem to be happy) tennis, yoga, and on and on.  Nice location less than 2 miles to olde town restaurants and bars.  The staff was magnificent and the rooms are very nice and a great size!  Highly recommend!

findings.title: Marian C. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Caution! Be very careful when you book here. We have been loyal patrons of this hotel since it first opened. The reservation department is not well trained and misinformed. We were moved, without our knowledge, or consent to a lesser and significantly smaller room which I discovered upon calling ahead. I told him to cancel the reservation. A day or two later I called to be sure he had cancelled and he had not done so. The Manager on duty was of no help. Now they have charged my credit card nearly $900 for something that was entirely their fault. We will never, ever go back. Go to The Boulders. You'll love it.

findings.title: Devin W. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Samantha was an excellent server at Mowry and Cotton. Great ambiance. Wasn't a 100%fan of the salmon but overall totally worth the price of admission. We would definitely go back as the sunsets from the restaurant is gorgeous  My friends and I really enjoyed our stay-cation there!

findings.title: Jill M. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
I've been coming to the Phoenician for over 20yrs and have stayed at the resort more than two dozen times. We haven't been since the renovation and since they took one of the 9 holes out from the golf course - taking it from 3 nines to 2. 

The Phoenician was once a gem of a resort with impeccable service and a boutique exclusive quaint feel. 

We returned to find that it has been turned into a Disney resort. The place is a sea of kids and a zoo of people and the service is horrible.

There are cheesy banners spread through the resort and pool areas promoting their new Kabobs. (Ones that you'd expect to see at the Holiday Inn).

The adult pool sits between two kids pools and the chairs are packed together like sardines - so much so you have to walk to the very end of the pool to get to your chair (no space between). Good luck on getting a drink or lunch by the pool - we just opened our own tab at the bar served ourselves and brought our own drinks and food back to our chairs from the bar.

We toured the new Spa and it looked decent and has a private pool. If you are an SPG Platinum or Bonvoy Platinum you can use the pool otherwise it is $50/person for a day pass. Seems worth it so we will try that on our last day. 

The best thing you can do Marriott (since you ruined Ritz and now you'll ruin Starwood) at this point is change the name from a "luxury resort collection" to the "Sheraton" brand - otherwise you are misleading people. Please rebrand as "Sheraton Phoenician"

Bye bye Phoenician it's been an incredible 20yrs and the memories were magical. You will be missed. Never coming back and you've been crossed off our list. Next visit will be at Sanctuary or Royal Palms.

findings.title: Darien R. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Just amazing, beautiful resort, very luxurious. Very nice pool with an amazing view to the mountains, the food is first class, fantastic service, best housekeeping I've ever seen. The gym is good enough for a gym with apples and water provided, I'm very lazy writing reviews but long story short the attention to detail is on point, I would 100% go back.

findings.title: Kate M. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
First time here for me - we arrived at 10am and they convinced us to take an "upgrade" to a residence rather than separate rooms. We were hesitant but said okay AS LONG AS it would be ready ASAP (i.e. cleaned immediately upon checkout) because we were already there and brought our dog, I.e. we couldn't go enjoy a lot of the resort spaces until our dog was set up in the room. We made it clear that just getting rooms early was our top priority.

6 HOURS later, and numerous conversations and phone calls later after leaving the property for lunch and then just basically sitting on benches waiting to get rooms and enjoy the resort, we are finally in our villa. Despite their multiple assurances and statements they did not prioritize the room with housekeeping and we weren't able to get in. No apologies, no complimentary drinks or anything to try to make up for making false promises. Basically we took off work and flew in early for nothing. We will likely not be returning. TERRIBLE customer service.

findings.title: Tilly R. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
I wanted to update my prior review of this hotel after my stay. Once we finally checked in (at 4:30 ish..so a five-hour​ wait from when we arrived), the room was nice and the bathroom was luxurious with Byredo products. Staff was attentive and kind. I got a massage and it was very nice, though expensive. The spa amenities were basic and the treatments were extremely over-priced. The best massage I've ever had is at the Scottsdale Princess, a much more luxurious spa. Food was mediocre​, so I suggest going out to eat. The beds were extremely comfortable, but I had to request my sheets be changed, something pretty common these days. They have a nice turndown service with free water bottles, chocolate, ice, and they remake your bed. There are nine pools I think, but there was nothing exceptional about them. They were all shallow, probably 3-4 ft max. Luckily there was an adult pool because there were kids with noodles in every other pool splashing everyone. 
A few things to note. No matter how many times you ask for lotion they only give you one extra at a time. I put it on my entire body, so that was inconvenient. They also add about at 25% tip or surcharge to everything, so know you don't have to tip. We wanted a taxi (yellow cab) and the​ men working the car valet area were perplexed and seemed to have a difficult time making that happen. 
A cool thing to check out is the man walking around with a hawk on his arm on the restaurant patio. He said he was doing "pest control", which sounded gruesome​ at first, but the waitress explained the hawk was well fed and just his presence scared birds off the patio. 
I don't know because​ I was lucky enough to have someone pay for my stay, but I read charges are added on randomly, so to check your bill carefully at the end. Supposedly internet is free, but it made me sign in and said a charge would be added to the room each day. The front desk person said the charge would be removed, but I can't vouch for that. 
All-in-all I think this hotel was nice​ but doesn't deserve five stars. The Westin is awesome, The Scottsdale Princess is great, there are just other ones that beat this out with service and amenities. 
My favorite part of this hotel was the massage, the turn-down service with free water bottles, and the​ bed.

findings.title: Kimberly M. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This hotel/ resort is one of my favorites. I would highly recommend this place. They know how to take care of their guests. The female reception manager is awesome. This is a place you want to stay at for the rest of your life. Impeccable service, towels are placed on your lounge chairs, turn-down service is wonderful, the activities for kids are of the highest quality.  The bunnies are so cute, the art  is interesting to view and read about, and then the outside activities and sites are just as impressive.  Also they have a game room for the kids, that is clean and nicely furnished.

findings.title: Mimi N. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
I am sitting in my "standard room" which smells like the Burger King.  That is because my room is directly below the restaurants on the 5th floor and the cooking smells must vent downward.  The front desk acted like no-one had ever complained about it, but several hotel staff members said that these rooms (main building 4th floor) get the cooking smells.  So this is a known problem.  The bathroom smells worse than the bedroom and when I open the "patio doors"  (overlooking a garage roof or some ugly roof)  the odor gets stronger.  So there is nothing that I can do to get fresh air or clean air into this room. I am stuck here for two nights.  BTW, I am convinced that they are also treating me like a second class citizen because I am using STARWOOD points and it takes  a lot of points, to pay for this room.  I have used points for the past 12 years in March and I have always just been given lovely rooms in the casitas. I have never stayed in the main hotel building and I would say, don't ever stay here, it is really horrible for the money and the hotel doesn't care.    

I have been a loyal visitor here, I usually stay 4 or 5 nights in March, this year I couldn't (thank god, I don't even know if I can handle one more night in this room) but loyalty doesn't mean anything to the front desk staff, so shame on you Phoenician for not taking care of me and for treating me this way because I am using points.  That's what the points are for, to use for hotel stays.  But in this case, I feel like I am sleeping inside of a fast food joint.  No resort should be renting out rooms that smell like bacon grease. Complete rip off, complete drag to be in the ghetto room as a big resort property.

findings.title: Megan T. (1/5)
findings.snippet: The front desk staff here is absolutely pompous and horrible.  Not at all worth the high price of these rooms to be treated this way.  What a rip off!

findings.title: Laurel C. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Stayed here with a large group for a work trip. I was extremely impressed with this beautiful resort. The rooms and space were gorgeous, the staff was professional and friendly. Everything we requested we received with a smile.

findings.title: Guy B. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
Nothing to complaint about the hotel which for Scottsdale   is decent , however the manager or the management do not understand what is good service , the  staff have been train to be robots and nobody can make a decision that is not guided by their computer , no common sense.For Oscar night, the manager refused to put the sound on the TV, same thing in the steak house  bar that was empty , the night was saved by the lobby bar manager that decided to make a decision.
As a platinum member I was refused a late check out , the story goes on and on about answering "absolutely at every turn " and not trying .
The new BONVOY tag line should be changed to NOVOY.

findings.title: Carlos A. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This place is amazing! The last time I came here was back in 2015 and boy have things changed. All the rooms have been renovated as well as the pools. The weather wasn't that great as it was rainy and temps were in the low 30's however the pools are heated which made it tolerable. Come check out this 5 diamond resort and enjoy all their amenities.

findings.title: Ts L. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The Phoenician is a nice retreat even for Arizona residents. It's nice to escape the snow if you live in Flagstaff. Great views too.

findings.title: Greg C. (2/5)
findings.snippet: Two stars because the resort is really nice. Two stars because they located us in Timbuktu and it was a long walk to get anywhere. Two stars because it's an extra $18/day for parking (really? pay that much and parking is not included?). They have a guard shack that everyone has to stop and check in at and 24 hour Valet and still someone stole my hoodie out of my car in the parking garage. I told one of their security staff just so they would know and they couldn't have cared less. Would not stay there again and for the money neither should you.

findings.title: Heba G. (5/5)
findings.snippet: We stayed here for only 2 nights, but it was the highlight of our trip. We planned to do activities nearby the hotel but abandoned all of them when seeing what this resort has to offer. Two nights was not even enough to tour around the whole resort and there was so much offered! All of my kids were satisfied and never got bored. Surprisingly, they did not want to leave the resort and wanted to explore the resort. There were basketball and tennis courts,  a trapeze court, a game room, several restaurants and more. The staff there was also excellent. They transported us with their golf carts around the large resort with no hassle or fees. Everyone there was so nice and helpful. The rooms were luxurious and everything was clean. There's also a hike trail just next to the resort with a beautiful view. Down below is a picture of the view from the top of the hike. They even gave us complimentary cookies and chocolates on Christmas. This resort is amazing!

findings.title: Linda S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This is the most beautiful place to come everyday. Camelback mountain is looming over this resort like a huge protector. The golf course has so much wildlife, geese, ducks, bunnies and many many fish. Such a wonderful place.

findings.title: Maysa M. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I loved everything about my stay here. We had the mountain view suite so every time we looked out the balcony, we saw the beautiful Camelback mountains. There's even lights around the cacti and scenery so it looks extra magical at night. The room itself was comfortable, spacious, and came with great amenities. The bathroom had a soaking tub which is great after a long hike at Camelback (trailhead is under a mile away from the resort entrance). As for the hotel itself, outside of the room, it's just as elegant. We designated time during our stay just to explore the hotel and the resort. The resort has multiple pools, heated jacuzzi, an awesome gym, and a fun game and pool for kids. There were also multiple gardens which were great for a romantic walk around. The service was amazing as well. I'd love to visit the resort even w/o staying the night l, since I'm local, if it weren't for the parking fees. It's to be expected though because of how nice this resort is ($18 overnight/8 hr parking).

findings.title: W H. (1/5)
findings.snippet: I wanted to like this resort but I don't think it's worth the price. It's considered one if he nicest resorts in Scottsdale but I'm not sure why. The customer service is average at best, the spa, food, etc. The whole experience was underwhelming - you pay a resort fee for I'm not sure what because they nickel and dime you for everything. For example, you get bike rentals but only 2 hours, free yoga but only at 7:30, towel service at the pool but can only sit in certain areas - some areas you have to pay extra. There was one person working the pool service - I felt bad for her. I kept hearing it was a holiday weekend which is why they should have increased staff. It's exhausting after a weekend where you just want to relax to have to figure out all these amenities with the resort fee are actually a joke. Further, the spa has peak and off peak rates and they automatically charge a 20% service charge. Meanwhile we go up to the rooftop spa pool and no one even offers us water- they are busy cleaning up for the day and it's only 5- they close at 7. The treatments are only 50 minutes and cost $200 minimum. The level of service is not matching the prices!

findings.title: Andie K. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Absolutely disappointed in this "hotel". Booked here a few months ago, was supposed to check in today but when we got to the front desk they told us they were overbooked. My dad's Physician conference is supposed to take place here. They didn't even call to tell us beforehand that the check-in date was changed to tomorrow. They just moved our check-in date without calling us beforehand. Who does that?! Horrendous management.

findings.title: Kristin L. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Beautifully redone resort. The spa and fitness center are phenomenal. Rooms are gorgeous and spacious. The pool and kids are there are also awesome. Only 5 min to fashion square and maybe 10 to old town. Great spot!

findings.title: Svitlana S. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
Not sure if my family will ever be back.  Checked in late at night... I always have a habit of checking the sheets with my flashlight.
Well... to my surprise... one of the beds were filthy (pub hair and stains....if you know what I mean) 
My kids almost slept in a filthy bed.

The sheets weren't changed from previous customers and they were disgusting.  Had to move in the middle of the night with my kids (after unpacking) into a downgraded room with no view and loud AC units.
Anyways... they did move us again the following day after my husband insisted.  

Resort is nice, pools are nice... location is great- but what a disappointment.  Really had high expectations for clean rooms.  
Also...management was very slow to resolve the issue with moving us into another room.

findings.title: Morgan R. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
We stayed at this hotel over New Years and we were excited because it was known as a nice resort central to Scottsdale. The service was very very slow . The first experience we had with bad service was at lunch when our waiter was rude and very short with us. He never poured any water and did not even check up on us. Our bags took over an hour to get to the room and each time we called for something they would completely forget and we would call back 30 min later to ask again. It would then take a very long time to get to us. This happened with the hide-a-bed we requested when we booked the room, towels, water, and dental kit. 

The resort itself is nice, but the service was disappointing.

findings.title: Danielle G. (5/5)
findings.snippet: My family and I attended afternoon tea and it was wonderful! Sabrina our server made everything great, and was very sweet and helpful. We really appreciated her service and smile!

findings.title: Tim S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The Phoenician is the place to stay in Scottsdale.    Luxury, top notch service from the valet parking, checkin, rooms, spa and OMG the pools are the BEST!   Pool service is FULL service and they have enough of staff you don't find yourself waiting for a towel, water or most important a good adult beverage!   Highly recommend!

findings.title: Laura A. (3/5)
findings.snippet:
Stunning Resort with Outstanding Restaurant Options but THE CUSTOMER SERVICE SUCKS.

I called twice to ask a specific question about a holiday menu. I reached a recording both times and on the second recording I left a message. Nobody returned my call. After a few days of nobody returning my call I messaged the restaurant on Facebook and nobody replied to my message...now almost a week later.

On another occasion the attendant in the security hut gave us incorrect directions to a new restaurant we where to dine at.

Stunning resort that should be 5 stars but the customer service is below average.

findings.title: Marci B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: We had the absolute best experience at the Phoenician. They went out of their way to make the holiday tea a positive experience for me and my family. We will definitely be back every year!!! The best customer service and Holiday tea experience we have ever had.

findings.title: Olivia B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Took my daughters to their "Afternoon Tea" and what a treat! Unbelievable service and the most gracious managers!! Welcomed us with open arms and attended to our every need. Helped my family to have an incredible experience. I will never go anywhere else. Left feeling so happy and pampered.

findings.title: Clarence A. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
One of the fanciest hotels I stayed at back in 2013 for a work function, The pools are amazing, the rooms are spacious, the staff were very stellar, I definitely recommend this hotel as a place to stay if you have the funds to stay here.

Upon checking in, in the front they did have some classic cars sitting in front, i'm pretty sure they were locals rides, older corvette, stunning white with red stripe down the middle, I want to say it was a 67 Corvette, well taken care off, literally the car was in pristine condition. The other vehicles were also nice but not as pristine as that corvette.

This hotel was very spacious, in the entrance, was a large fountain, that opens to a large lobby with a view when you walk to the end of the lobby you can see pools, and sectioned out area to your right that was a large koi pond, the bars seemed to be on every corner of the pools, both pools one on top the other below it had a waterfall effect going on, plenty of shade for folks that want to bask in the desert sun but not directly if they chose not too.

If you want first class this place definitely made you feel first class, again definitely recommend this hotel if you can afford it, went during the month of October, still remember walking around this hotel and finding new things each time I walked around, the weather was still hot during the night was humid and slightly windy. 

For a corporate event, definitely a place you want to have your party, they have almost everything, laundry service, food service, sections where you literally can take a golf cart to get to the next section of the hotel.

hotel ***** 
price $$$$
service *****
ambiance *****

definite must stay if you are in the area

findings.title: Wendy K. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
The price of the hotel is worth it.  I have stayed at several nice hotels and the customer service at this hotel was exceptional.  They called us by our last name the entire stay and were truly making sure we were happy the whole time we were there.  Very clean and the property was gorgeous. We went in December and the hotel
Was decorated beautifully.  There were several pools so it never felt crowded and the pool side service was fabulous and delicious. Give any of the jalapeño drinks a try (spicy and yummy)

findings.title: Alice L. (1/5)
findings.snippet: My husband and I went to the Phoenician Lobby Bar for some food and drinks.  Upon departure, my husband requested that his parking receipt be "validated."  He  asked twice, before he was finally given a validation receipt.  When we got to the exit, we realized that the validation receipt, that he was given, had expired on 12/6/2018.  Really?????  Very disappointing!!

findings.title: Stephen F. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
5+ stars. This is a resort that acts like what you'd want from a resort. Front the time you roll up to the last detail. Actually from the time you book your reservation they reach out via email to see if you have any special requests or are celebrating anything. They ask again at check in and again for dinner reservations. They constantly try to make your stay special. 
The resort property is beautiful and set against Camelback Mountain. The views are spectacular in every direction. 
We would fly to Arizona just to go to the resort. Can't wait to get back.

findings.title: Heather H. (1/5)
findings.snippet: Tried to make a reservation here and was transferred several times.  No one seems to know what they are doing.  I even had a guy take my name, email, and reservation, then he did nothing with it.  When I called again to make the reservation, the lady transferred me, and lo and behold they were now full for the only dates I could go.  Better service at Holiday Inn Express.

findings.title: Carey S. (1/5)
findings.snippet: This hotel is pretty- but the service is ATROCIOUS.  We came for 4 nights, my sister and our two 3 year olds, hoping for some relaxation and pampering- the first two days nobody cleaned my sisters room (the last day they cleaned her room only because she called); the last day nobody cleaned mine. They are horribly understaffed- it took well over an hour to get food when we ordered room service or when we used the restaurants.  There was literally no service at the pool- just one bartender that was completely swamped trying to make drinks for the entire pool (I should note the pool area was at most 1/3 full).  Food quality was pretty mediocre- my nephews chicken ordered via room service (that took over an hour to have delivered) was raw in the middle.  It took 45 minutes for them to get lucky charms for my daughter at the restaurant for breakfast. We are currently sitting at the lobby bar on our last night and have been waiting at least 30 minutes for our drinks.  The servers they do have are nice but the repose time is sooooooo sloooooow.  So so so bad.  I can't even imagine how bad it is when the resort is full!!!!

findings.title: Simone H. (5/5)
findings.snippet: (05/2015) I really needed to review this amazing hotel as I'm going back to Scottsdale soon, and I may or may not stay here again. This is one of the most, if not the most, beautiful hotels I have ever stayed in. So many amenities, the pools, the service, A1. Extremely expensive, but, hey. I went for a conference, and we stayed here, and it's truly worth it. I went in May, the weather was awesome, several clubs and nightlife near by the hotel on the strip. For the record, the Manhattans made at the bar overlooking the pool/courtyard grass area, with the black cherries soaked in brandy garnish, best and strongest in the world. 2 1/2 of those and you are done. The on-site spa was awesome as well. I got a full body swedish massage. Highly recommend if you need a place to stay in Scottsdale.

findings.title: Jason Y. (4/5)
findings.snippet: This resort is beautiful. Behind the resort is the Camelback Mountains. Beautiful mountain but hard to hike because of all the gravel. Not a easy hike for thos non experienced. The resort itself is very nice. Staff is very nice and helpful. Walking around the resort is very nice. With the resort fee you are able to do so many things. I would stay here again if I was in this area.

findings.title: Jennifer D. (5/5)
findings.snippet: What a lovely place to stop in for an evening cocktail! The patio was stunning and the glass fire pit was beautiful. The staff was super attentive and my cocktail was lovely. So, if you are looking for a place to have a drink with friends overlooking some incredible scenery, then this is your kind of place. Do expect to pay more for those drinks but a little treat now and then is always fun.

findings.title: Briana B. (2/5)
findings.snippet:
My husband and I stayed here the 17th-19th of October.  My company treated us to this trip, along with several other members of our team.  Let me begin by saying that the accommodations and grounds were lovely!  90% of the staff were also wonderful- Especially those tending to folks relaxing by the pool.  Ariel and Juda were just awesome, and the staff at the Marketplace is just the sweetest!  It is because of folks like this that I rated the experience as high as I did.  With that, I add that a manager (and GOSH, I wish I remembered his name) at your (J&G?) Steakhouse completely RUINED our evening the night of the 18th.  I have had better food and service at Applebees back home (a pretty "economical" restaurant in the Midwest).  Yes, my husband and I may not "look the part" for your resort (each of us is covered in tattoos), but we have had our share of $200 dinners and NOT been made to feel as though we didn't belong somewhere.  And even then, at least the food was good.  The first steak I tried was abysmal... and after sending it back, the replacement was better.  But it wasn't the steak that put the bad taste in my mouth- It was that manager, and if I am being honest, MOST of the staff there.  He did get an earful from one of my colleagues, as we were ignored for the better part of an hour.  He "graciously" took care of our bar tab (non-existent for most of the table).  I honestly wish at that point we had just left.  Our "highlight" dinner on our getaway had been soured the moment he spoke to me when we walked in.  I work everyday with people from all walks of life, and customer service is extremely important to me... I would be mortified if one of my clients felt as though I thought them not worthy of the same service as my next client.  On a brighter note, your front desk Staff and in-room dining Team were very accommodating when it came to my "special need."  I am a breastfeeding mother that was trying to keep up with a tiny, hungry 7 month old back home in Ohio.  I had to pump every 2-3 hours on my trip, and your Staff was so kind when I (nervously) asked if they could freeze the whole cooler stash for me to fly back home with... Though they could be trained to not look so horrified when asked (I jest, lol).  Thank you Kevin, for being so accommodating with that!  My daughter appreciates it :)  I would love to say that I would recommend The Phonecian to folks, but I am not sure that is going to be possible.  Or maybe I recommend that folks just steer clear of the judge-y Steakhouse on premesis, unless being treated like shit for $200 is your thing? 
 Take that for what it is worth, and hopefully learn from it.  Thank you for your time, from Ohio,

Carl & Briana Schwind

findings.title: Brett B. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Its funny how you can stay at one of the nicest hotels in the state but the toilet paper is still shitty

findings.title: Farnaz N. (4/5)
findings.snippet: The Phoenician is a very large resort with multiple restaurants and pools etc. They even have shops and little market places. It's definitely high end and I felt a little out of place walking around in a T shirt and shorts while people in suits were walking around me. There's lots of businesses who have conventions and meetings here. They have a splash pad and a kids pool and a kids care area but you have to make a 24 hr in advance reservation in order to drop off your child there. Although the place is kid friendly, there's not too many kids there. The splash pad was empty. Also, the room didn't have Disney or Nickelodeon on their TV cable channel which was disappointing. The Activity Center below the gym area was super nice! Overall a good experience but I wouldn't go back personally.

findings.title: Julie G. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I had enjoyed a wonderful relaxing weekend at the Phoenician. Everyone and everything was extraordinary from the room, restaurant (breakfast out on the terrace with the hawks, to keep the other birds away is always   a treat), bar lounge to the pool service not to mention the spa services. Exceptional.

findings.title: Jill R. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Beautiful hotel w nice rooms, pools, great restaurants and nice friendly staff. We really enjoyed the adults only pool with big umbrellas available & the staff that constantly comes around with iced water pitchers. Also, lunch waitress/ waiter service is available at the pool that comes to your seat. Food was very good as well. The rooms are nicely done, balconies, and very nice baths and showers with separate toilet area enclosed. They also have a resort fee and charge for parking which is an extra though as well.  We would definitely think about staying again when in the area.

findings.title: Brittany C. (1/5)
findings.snippet: ZERO, ZERO, ZERO stars! Very confused by the 5 star ratings. My husband booked a casita for Mother's Day weekend and we were immediately blown away by the foul valet staff. What a great way to be greeted on a special weekend. I asked to speak to the manager who completely brushed me off. The room was nothing spectacular and very dated. Restaurants close early and don't cater to food allergies so beware. Had to leave the resort for dinner. Pool was ok, my children had fun but charge $50 per person per pool chair. I had a 1 year old and 3 year old and was told I had to pay $100 for them even though they sat on my chair. This led us to pay $300 in just pool chairs because there was no where else to sit. Absolutely Ridiculous. Customer service is massively lacking. We will never return or ever ever recommend, there are much better upscale resorts that are actually 'Luxury' to stay while in Scottsdale.

findings.title: Joe C. (4/5)
findings.snippet:
This athletic club is top notch with brand new equipment and on demand classes. I'd give it a 5 star but the lack of air circulation makes it a bit warm. The treadmills have a fan built in but it is very weak, I've used other matrix equipment with much stronger fans. 

The bathroom is also located outside, downstairs and around the building which is a bit inconvenient.

findings.title: Mohammad H. (5/5)
findings.snippet: The Best Stake House  with great service Beautiful  ambience & great resort with  fantastic views

findings.title: Imelda O. (4/5)
findings.snippet: Beautiful resort and very friendly staff. I was there for a work event and enjoyed the amenities. The dinner served during the event was ok, chicken and veggies were hard and cold. Maybe this had to do with the amount of people attending and food just gets cold. But other than that my experience was great, a staff attendant saw me walking to my car and offered me a ride on a golf cart to my car. Very friendly and attentive.

findings.title: Amy S. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Unfortunately, I can only give this phenomenal resort 5 stars, because it deserves MORE!!! This has by far, been the best experience I have ever had at a resort. The service is second to none. I have never been happier spending my money, than here in Scottsdale, and specifically, The Phoenician. Again, the service is just second to none. I know I'm missing the names of many people who have made our stay, super fantastic, so I apologize, but I must recognize Hannah at the Kalio Kabobery for her great service, gift of gab and great recommendations, Maria and Larissa, the detail oriented housekeeping staff, Arturo and Dora at Mowry & Cotton, who gave us such a great dining experience, Adrianna and Kyra with the Phoenician Spa, who was able to get us a private aerial yoga class, our amazing yoga instructor Rhonda, with Metta, and last but not least, Paige, the Concierge extraordinaire, who went above and beyond time and time again. Absolutely a fantastic experience all around. Everyone here wants you to have a great experience and it's a GENUINE desire to make each and every experience the best!!! That is hard to find. Thank you so much and I look forward to returning soon!!!

findings.title: Lori B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: Have a hydra facial at the new spa at the resort. It's amazing. If you want to see instant results this is your treatment. And I have to say the pedicure room is one of the most beautiful spaces to sit and enjoy your pedicure. If booking nail service ask for Pam

findings.title: Mary A. (1/5)
findings.snippet: We had afternoon tea at the Phoenician. The food was good but the service was terrible. We had reservations and were seated at the rear of the tearoom. The service started out fine but as time went on the service got worse and we were pretty much ignored for the second and third course. We waited a long time for the second course and had to flag down the waitress for more ice water and more hot water for our tea. We had to flag down the waitress once again to bring the third course. The tearoom was very busy, the other tables were taken care of but for some reason we were not. I think they forgot about us. I would love to go back because the food and tea selections are delicious but I'm not planning to anytime soon.

findings.title: LJ Z. (5/5)
findings.snippet: This hotel has always been a favorite of mine. However I had reserved an extended stay here based on part from assurances their wonderful J&G Steakhouse would be opened at the beginning of September. Unfortunately when I checked in I was informed the renovations in the restaurant were taking longer than forecasted, and hence the restaurant would be closed during my entire stay. Paige, however, in the Concierge office made my trip more than enjoyable with her attention to detail. From Paige to the myriad spa treatments and helpful staff, this trip did not disappoint.

findings.title: Natalie C. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
Stayed at the Phoenician over the Labor Day weekend. Purchased 2 casitas for my family and my sisters family to celebrate the holiday weekend and our recent birthdays. Around 10 pm at night I noticed the water filling the sink and the bath tub were yellow tinted and dirty. Fortunately the front desk was able to move us to another room that was across a parking lot. Needing to rebath my children and myself we packed up our room, and carried our sleeping children to the new room.
When checking out the front desk manager was rude and since we had booked our rooms with Expedia, a third party, he was unable to make any consessions towards our rooms. I am not the type to complain about the few issues we encountered while staying at the property, but I was very surprised by the lack of courtesy the front desk manager had for our dirty water room, late night packing, moving rooms and my daughter becoming very upset that something was wrong with our room that could not be fixed. I am so disgusted by the fact that my family bathed, washed our face, brushed our teeth with dirty water at this resort. Our primary vacation due to my work, is staycation.... there is not a resort in Scottsdale/Phoenix/Tucson that we have not stayed at 5-3 stars.... skip this resort and go to the Hyatt at Gainey Ranch.... same family fun and entertainment.... clean water...

findings.title: J V. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
I was very excited when the Phoenician became a Luxury Collection Resort as a SPG and Marriott member. 
 I have visited the spa before since 1990 when I moved to town and stayed at the resort many times over the years, I was greatly disappointed in my latest spa visit with my daughter.   Our massages were scheduled for 11:00 AM. We arrived at 10:00 AM and went to the front desk. I gave the spa representative my name, massage time and asked if we had enough time to do some of the yoga class. There were only two classes on Sunday at 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM.  The representative assured us we could do the class and check in afterwards which is what we did.  After leaving the class, we went to the spa desk again to find out from another representative that we were not in fact checked in and had missed 15 minutes of our massage.  In point of fact, we received only 30 minutes of a massage and were rushed through the process.  I pointed out to the representative that they should have come into the studio (which was a few feet from the desk) since they knew where we were to get us when it was time for our massage.  In fact, they did not check us in when I asked them to at 10:00 AM and it was never communicated to anyone we were in the spa facility we were at the spa.  This error resulted in us missing the massage service and made for a rushed and disappointing day.  I have precious little free time (especially with my daughter) and this day was to be a time of rejuvenation and a reunion for us.  We did not have time to change for the massage but brought all out items into the room with us for the most rushed and stressful 30 minute massage experience.  

When this was explained to the representatives ate reception desk, they offered not alternatives.   I inquired  if we could reschedule but was told there was only time at 6:00 PM for one of us to reschedule.   I was not offered another day, any other compensations or alternative services.  This was to be a day of rejuvenation and relaxation with my daughter as we have such precious little time available to us.   It could not have been more stressful and disappointing.  After explaining this again to the staff, they said they would check with management.  As a consolation, we were offered lunch at the roof top pool as a compensation which I feel is not adequate for two missed massages which were the only service we scheduled that day.  As we arrived at the pool, we were informed our lunch did not include a drink.  The roof top pool is sterile without any plants to give it an inviting appeal.  As a roof top experience, it was very hot and some cooling features should be considered for aesthetics and comfort.  You could not stay at the pool for more than an hour at most.

I would not expect this type of experience from a  luxury resort with a reputation for customer service.  We will not be returning to the hotel or spa for spa services,  vacation stays, dining or reception services.    It would have been expected that the spa staff take responsibility for their error and not hold the customer accountable for their error.  It's very sad to believe this is the best the Phoenician could offer a customer for their error.

The spa building itself is apart from the hotel. It has been remodeled and has nice sitting to wait for your services areas. However, there are no lounges for resting except 4 by the indoor heated spa pool.  It was hard to find a place to really relax and rejuvenate.  There are better spas in town with lovely lounges, pillows, music and snacks to relax as you wait for services or just take a nap.


J
Scottsdale, AZ
I

findings.title: Lexi R. (1/5)
findings.snippet:
I'll start by saying this place is absolutely gorgeous and has a very luxurious look. The restaurant food is the most amazing food I've ever had, the room service food is alright. $20 for a hamburger that was drenched in salt, not my cup of tea. 

My boyfriend and I came here for our two year anniversary. We were only going to stay one night but it was so awesome that we added another one. Bad idea. Other than going out to eat at the amazing restaurants for every meal, our plan was to just chill in the room all day and chillax. 

Well I don't know how else to put this than that the customer service SUCKS! The employees here have a serious communication issue, maybe if they had walkies it would be a lot better. 
House keeping came to our door at 11am, we wanted a little time to get ready so we asked if they could come back in 30 minutes, we were told yes. Than 5 minutes another person came and we had the same convo. Okay. We go out to eat and come back about 45 later and the room is still a mess. We called the office and they said someone was on their way to clean it. Okay. We decided to go to our house to check on our animals (2 hour round trip) and came back, room still wasn't touched! We are pretty upset at this point because we were planning on sitting in bed all day, and we shouldn't have to do that on dirty sheets and with trash everywhere (we PAID for a good experience). So anyways we call again and same thing happened. Someone was "on their way". We went to lunch, came back, room was still messy. So finally we call and they say someone is on their way. No. One. Comes. WHAT IS WRONG WITH THIS PLACE? Why have I a CUSTOMER been lied to multiple times? Why not just be upfront and say we aren't coming today????? So finally at 5pm a nice gentlemen, Israel, comes to the door to not clean the room but to give us water and chocolate. We were telling him about our issue and he offered to clean our room! A nice guy and went above and beyond and picked up his fellow employees slack. 

I'm really upset that I didn't get my room cleaned until 6pm, which I should be. And than to add to that, we get a call that our card wasn't going through (just some bank stuff). We were told a golf cart would come down and get us and take us to the main office so that we don't have to walk, and that they'd leave now. We waited a while and still nobody came. So we ended up walking up there. It's not that we had to walk that bothers me, but that nobody here can keep their work. I spent $700+ at this place for a great weekend and got nothing but empty words and have learned that the employees here really just talk out of their A$$!!

findings.title: Alex B. (5/5)
findings.snippet: I cannot begin to say enough positive things about this resort. From the moment we got out of our car to the moment we left. There were bellhops taking our luggage up to our room and the front desk was so helpful. As we walked to our room there are beautiful shops and a market to grab food or coffee to go. The bedrooms were gorgeous. They were clean and up to date. Very modern and sleek looking. We spent several days by the pool. The staff at the pool is amazing. Everyone is so accommodating and so kind no matter what your request it. Someone is constantly making sure you have a cold ice water pitcher and that you are comfortable. The grounds at this hotel were kept in pristine condition. I cant think of enough positive things to say about this resort. I look forward to my next stay whenever that may be!

findings.title: De'Anna W. (5/5)
findings.snippet:
I really enjoyed my stay here even though it was a last minute thing for me and I stayed for less than 24 hours checked in at about 11 PM and checked out the next day at 1 PM. The property is gorgeous. It's like it's own little village. Super nice staff, high tech elevators lol, large spacious rooms. 

Room: the bed was so comfortable and the shower was awesome. I was able to stay on the fourth floor looking over the pool and at night it was so pretty. 

Breakfast was delicious and our server was very nice and accommodating. I tried the acai bowl with a side of fruit with a glass of green juice and everything was fresh and flavorful. 

Pool: There are several pools, a water slide, kids area, adults area etc. We were some of the only people out there so it felt like a private pool. Great views. The frozen drinks by the pool aren't that great but our waitress was nice to switch them out for something more enjoyable. 

Staff: very nice and the customer service is on point.
